title: K-flat comparison naturality for compatible restriction squares
statement: Let j:X to Y be an open immersion of schemes. On Y take E,K,M,F,N and r:E to M, q:K to M, s:F to N; on X take corresponding primed complexes and maps. Assume E,K,F and E-prime,K-prime,F-prime K-flat, and all six augmentation maps quasi-isomorphisms. Given five chain maps from the restrictions of E,K,M,F,N to their primed counterparts, assume the squares for r,q,s commute. In every integer degree, exact restriction of the common K-flat comparison followed by the induced restricted tensor homology map at K,N equals the induced map at E,N followed by the primed comparison, with inverse exact-restriction homology isomorphisms at the two endpoints. Definitions: [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology].

source.place: Tag 06YT, comparison through a common K-flat resolution; Tag 08DX(2), affine derived tensor computation.

proof.text: Apply tensorResolution_restrictedTensor_square to id_E and s, r and id_F, q and id_F, and id_K and s, using the three assumed squares and the identity squares. This gives all four compatible tensor squares.

K-flat tensor invariance supplies quasi-isomorphisms for the first and third backward legs on both schemes. Apply tensorResolution_homology_zigzag to the exact restriction functor and the four commuting squares.
Rewrite both comparison homs with their defining four-map equation and reassociate composition. This is the equation just obtained from the homology zigzag.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorResolutionComparison_restriction {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (E K M F N : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (E' K' M' F' N' : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (r : E ⟶ M) (q : K ⟶ M) (s : F ⟶ N)
    (r' : E' ⟶ M') (q' : K' ⟶ M') (s' : F' ⟶ N')
    (hE : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) E)
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) K)
    (hF : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) F)
    (hE' : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) E')
    (hK' : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) K')
    (hF' : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) F')
    (hr : QuasiIso r) (hq : QuasiIso q) (hs : QuasiIso s)
    (hr' : QuasiIso r') (hq' : QuasiIso q') (hs' : QuasiIso s')
    (e : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj E ⟶ E')
    (k : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K ⟶ K')
    (m : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M ⟶ M')
    (f : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F ⟶ F')
    (t : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N ⟶ N')
    (hrr : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map r ≫ m =
      e ≫ r')
    (hqq : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map q ≫ m =
      k ≫ q')
    (hss : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map s ≫ t =
      f ≫ s') (i : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).map
        (tensorResolutionComparison Y.sheaf E K M F N r q s hE hK hF hr hq hs i).hom ≫
      (((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K N (curriedTensor Y.Modules)).sc i).mapHomologyIso
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j)).inv ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (tensorResolutionRestrictionTensorMap j K N K' N' k t) i =
    (((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor E N (curriedTensor Y.Modules)).sc i).mapHomologyIso
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j)).inv ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (tensorResolutionRestrictionTensorMap j E N E' N' e t) i ≫
      (tensorResolutionComparison X.sheaf E' K' M' F' N' r' q' s'
        hE' hK' hF' hr' hq' hs' i).hom
